title: OpenAI apologizes to Australia after its AI agents breached government sites
snippet: The company also detailed how some of those breaches had happened, and outlined additional measures it is taking to assess the impact of the events.

title: Reco raises $55M as AI agent security startups crowd the market
snippet: The round builds on a $30 million fundraise in February, taking the company's total funding to $140 million.

title: Protego Ventures closes debut $125 million fund for Israeli defense tech
snippet: Protego Ventures, the first and largest dedicated defense tech VC in Israel, just completed its final $125 million closing, TechCrunch learned exclusively.
